---
title: "Benchmarks"
subtitle: "The corpus: 118 programs in 8 suites from PRL-PRG/r-benchmarks"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
m <- REF_MACHINE
r <- D$runs[D$runs$machine == m & D$runs$kind == "release" & D$runs$config == "default", ]
lr <- r[which.max(r$date), ]
base <- D$baselines[[m]]
e_last <- D$est[D$est$run == lr$run, ]
e_base <- D$est[D$est$run == base$run, ]
sp <- speedups(e_base, e_last)
pl <- D$profiles[D$profiles$run == lr$run, ]
top <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(pl, pl$benchmark), function(x) x[which.max(x$share), ]))
nchg <- table(D$changes$benchmark)
```

```{r}
b <- D$benchmarks
tab <- data.frame(
  suite = b$suite,
  benchmark = b$id,
  min_r = b$min_version,
  t_base = e_base$est_ms[match(b$id, e_base$benchmark)],
  t_last = e_last$est_ms[match(b$id, e_last$benchmark)],
  speedup = sp$speedup[match(b$id, sp$benchmark)],
  top = top$category[match(b$id, top$benchmark)],
  top_share = top$share[match(b$id, top$benchmark)],
  devel = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(nchg[b$id]), 0, nchg[b$id])),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rs_table(tab, searchable = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 25,
  defaultSorted = list(suite = "asc"),
  columns = list(
    suite = colDef(name = "Suite", minWidth = 110),
    benchmark = colDef(name = "Benchmark", minWidth = 240,
      cell = function(v) tags$a(href = paste0(gsub("/", "--", v, fixed = TRUE), ".html"), sub("^[^/]+/", "", v))),
    min_r = colDef(name = "Needs R", minWidth = 80),
    t_base = colDef(name = paste("R", base$version), cell = function(v) fmt_ms(v), minWidth = 90),
    t_last = colDef(name = paste("R", lr$version), cell = function(v) fmt_ms(v), minWidth = 90),
    speedup = colDef(name = "Speedup", cell = function(v) fmt_speedup(v), minWidth = 85),
    top = colDef(name = "Most time in", minWidth = 120),
    top_share = colDef(name = "share", cell = function(v) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * v), minWidth = 70),
    devel = colDef(name = "R-devel changes", minWidth = 95)
  ))
```

::: {.rs-notes}
- Each benchmark is one R file defining `execute(size)`, run by the shared harness. Sources, sizes and provenance are in [PRL-PRG/r-benchmarks](https://github.com/PRL-PRG/r-benchmarks).
:::
